summary: @servicetitan/anvil2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, string-dispatch objects) that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/...zip` into a tempdir, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, then invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated JS blob using a ~1000-entry numeric constants array and a `WV8StW` rotation function. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped at the tarball root but are not listed in `package.json`'s `files` field (`["dist","token","CHANGELOG.md"]`) and are unreferenced by the library's `main`/exports; they exist solely to run at install time. Executing an opaque payload via a freshly-downloaded alien runtime bypasses Node-based install-time scanners and is inconsistent with the package's stated purpose as a React design system.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
